tasks.subject: Task 1: CsScanTrim pure vocabulary
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Core library: rect from two picked points, clamp/round, derivative filename build+parse, Trimmed-path predicate, ScanTrim tag serialize/parse.

**Files:**
- scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsScanTrim.js
- scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsAll.js
- tests/js_unit.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] rectFromPicks flips model y-up to image row-down
- [ ] normalise clamps, rounds, and rejects under 20px
- [ ] fileName/parseName round-trip a rect
- [ ] isTrimPath matches whole path segments only
- [ ] serialize/parse round-trip the ScanTrim text
- [ ] CsScanTrim.js is included by CsAll.js and listed in js_unit CORE_FILES

**Verify:** `/Applications/CaveCAD.app/Contents/MacOS/CaveCAD -no-dock-icon -no-gui -allow-multiple-instances -autostart tests/js_unit.js "$PWD"`

**Steps:** see the task's section in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-31-scan-trim.md — every step there carries the full code.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Write the derivative file
tasks.description:
**Goal:** CsScanTrim.write crops the page with QImage and saves a PNG into <scans>/Trimmed/, reusing an identical existing derivative and reporting every failure by name.

**Files:**
- scripts/CaveSurvey/Core/CsScanTrim.js
- tests/scan_trim_run.js
- tests/run_all.sh

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] the derivative is exactly the box's pixel size
- [ ] the cropped PIXELS are the right ones (marker pixel at the box-relative offset)
- [ ] a repeated identical box reuses the file without rewriting it
- [ ] an unwritable folder or unreadable page returns an error, never a throw
- [ ] run_all.sh gains a 14th section and its banners are renumbered

**Verify:** `/Applications/CaveCAD.app/Contents/MacOS/CaveCAD -no-dock-icon -no-gui -allow-multiple-instances -autostart tests/scan_trim_run.js "$PWD"`

**Steps:** see the task's section in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-31-scan-trim.md — every step there carries the full code.

tasks.subject: Task 4: ScanTrim tag on placed images
tasks.description:
**Goal:** insert and insertFitted take an optional trim rect and record it, while SketchScan keeps naming the ORIGINAL page so the shelf's ticks and placedScales still find it.

**Files:**
- scripts/CaveSurvey/SketchScans/SketchScans.js
- tests/scan_trim_run.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] a trimmed placement carries ScanTrim = x,y,w,h
- [ ] a whole-page placement carries no ScanTrim tag
- [ ] SketchScan still names the page
- [ ] the tag is written BEFORE the entity is added
- [ ] scan_reanchor_run.js still passes

**Verify:** `/Applications/CaveCAD.app/Contents/MacOS/CaveCAD -no-dock-icon -no-gui -allow-multiple-instances -autostart tests/scan_trim_run.js "$PWD" && /Applications/CaveCAD.app/Contents/MacOS/CaveCAD -no-dock-icon -no-gui -allow-multiple-instances -autostart tests/scan_reanchor_run.js "$PWD"`

**Steps:** see the task's section in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-31-scan-trim.md — every step there carries the full code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/CaveSurvey/SketchScans/SketchScans.js", "tests/scan_trim_run.js"], "verifyCommand": "/Applications/CaveCAD.app/Contents/MacOS/CaveCAD -no-dock-icon -no-gui -allow-multiple-instances -autostart tests/scan_trim_run.js \"$PWD\" && /Applications/CaveCAD.app/Contents/MacOS/CaveCAD -no-dock-icon -no-gui -allow-multiple-instances -autostart tests/scan_reanchor_run.js \"$PWD\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["a trimmed placement carries ScanTrim = x,y,w,h", "a whole-page placement carries no ScanTrim tag", "SketchScan still names the page", "the tag is written BEFORE the entity is added", "scan_reanchor_run.js still passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Rubber-band box in the preview
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Left-dragging in the Scan Shelf preview draws a live rectangle in the scratch document and hands the caller the two model points on release, without disturbing middle-drag pan, wheel zoom, or the station picker.

**Files:**
- scripts/CaveSurvey/SketchScans/ScanView.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] armBox arms and disarms boxing mode
- [ ] a left drag draws a band that follows the cursor
- [ ] release reports {a,b} model points
- [ ] onScanPick does not fire while boxing
- [ ] pan and wheel zoom still work
- [ ] a bare click reports nothing
- [ ] every mapping goes through CsScanView.viewPos (Retina)

**Verify:** `/Applications/CaveCAD.app/Contents/MacOS/CaveCAD -no-dock-icon -no-gui -allow-multiple-instances -autostart tests/js_syntax.js "$PWD"`

tasks.subject: Task 6: Trim bar and the placement gate
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Selecting a scan arms trim; Insert, Insert & Align, Assign Stations to Scans and Sketch Section stay disabled until a box is drawn or Use whole page is pressed; every path reads SketchScans.effectivePath.

**Files:**
- scripts/CaveSurvey/SketchScans/SketchScans.js

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] the trim bar shows state, Use whole page, and Redo box
- [ ] all four placement controls are gated on the choice
- [ ] drawing a box writes the derivative and reloads the preview from it
- [ ] Use whole page writes nothing
- [ ] Redo box restores the page and re-disables the buttons
- [ ] selecting another scan resets the trim state
- [ ] a failed write shows the error and leaves the buttons disabled

**Verify:** `./tests/run_all.sh`

**Steps:** see the task's section in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-31-scan-trim.md — every step there carries the full code.
